Khali @ Khaleel Khan vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 12
July, 2024
Author: Maninder S. Bhatti

Bench: Maninder S. Bhatti

 In The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Jabalpur
 Before
 Hon'Ble Shri Justice Maninder S. Bhatti
 On The 12 th Of July, 2024
 Criminal Appeal No. 5956 of 2024
 Khali @ Khaleel Khan
 Versus
 The State Of Madhya Pradesh And Others
 Appearance:

entities.text:
High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Jabalpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Shri Sharad Verma - Advocate for the appellant.
Shri K.V.S. Rao - Panel Lawyer for the State.

Order 
This is the first appeal filed by the appellant under Section 14-A of the SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act in connection with FIR/Crime No.113/2024 dated 25.7.2023 registered at Police Station Kotwali, District Damoh for the offences punishable under Sections 342, 376, 506, 323, 366 of IPC and Sections 3(1)(w)(i), 3(2)(v) and 3(1)(w)(ii), 3(2)(v-a) of the SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989.
2. The counsel for the appellant submits that the appellant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the case.
It is submitted that during course of trial, statement of the prosecutrix has been recorded before the trial Court on 2.7.2024.
She has not supported the case of the prosecution and turned hostile.

The statement of the prosecutrix has been brought on record along with I.A. No.
16750/2024.

It is further submitted that the appellant is in custody since 7.2.2024 and has suffered the incarceration of more than 5 months and trial will take considerable time to conclude, therefore,
the appellant be released on bail.

3. The counsel for the State has opposed the prayer for bail and 2 CRA-5956-2024 submitted that the appellant is a hardened criminal and in past as many as 7 cases were registered against him between the year 2012 to 2024.

It is thus contended that looking to allegations levelled agaisnt the appellant including the statement of the prosecutrix recorded under Section 164, the appellant is not entitled to be released on bail.
4.
Heard the submissions advanced on behalf of the parties and perused the statement of the prosecutrix recorded before the trial Court during trial.

sentences.text: On perusal of the statement of the prosecutrix recorded before the trial Court during trial makes it clear that the prosecutrix has not supported the case of the prosecution and turned hostile.
She has not stated anything against the appellant.

6. Thus, considering the statement of the prosecutrix recorded during trial, this Court deems it to be a fit case to release the appellant on bail, therefore, without commenting on the merit of the case,
this appeal is allowed.
7.

It is directed that appellant Khali @ Khaleel Khan shall be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond in a sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court concerned for his regular appearance before said Court on all such dates as may be fixed by that Court in this regard during pendency of trial.

8. It is directed that the appellant shall abide by the conditions enumerated under Section 437(3) of Cr.P.C.
